setup: f(x) = [[a]]x + [[b]], and you want the x that makes f(x) = [[y]].

steps.say: Working out a function goes forwards; finding which input gives an output goes backwards, so treat f(x) = [[y]] as the equation [[a]]x + [[b]] = [[y]] and solve it.
Subtracting [[b]] gives [[a]]x = [[rhs]], and dividing by [[a]] isolates x.
